claims.text: The three variants of cross-validation examined are: 10-fold stratified blocked cross-validation, 10-fold non-stratified blocked cross-validation, and 10-fold stratified random selection of examples.
Blocked cross-validation is specifically designed to cope with dependency in time-ordered data.
Stratified cross-validation ensures that each fold has roughly the same class distribution, which is important for balanced performance estimates.
